select
  date(c.created_at) as cart_date,
  to_char(c.created_at, 'Day') as day_of_week,
  count(*) as carts_created,
  round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where c.status = 'converted') / count(*), 1) as overall_conversion_pct
from carts c
join tenants t on t.id = c.tenant_id
where t.name = 'Cragsley Outfitters'
  and date(c.created_at) between date '2025-09-29' and date '2025-11-25'
  and extract(isodow from c.created_at) in (1, 2)
group by date(c.created_at), to_char(c.created_at, 'Day')
order by cart_date asc
